column3: by that the one Self of all embodied beings
by the younger brother of Love
with crown, girdle, string, beautiful anklets
having given up actions, left their kinsmen and relations
having given up compassion, kin and friends
of one who has given up shame
having abandoned shame, who attribute doership to you
like Death that has given up anger
about to give up the body, thought
should abandon, whose husband is abroad
like a king of the wicked
with the wish to make give up
I will make you give up the name
by the mere wish of the three
of the three with one feeling
from the knowledge of the three Vedas
unbroken Agnihotra for thirteen thousand years
the ocean frightened, a bridge built
protector of those who took refuge
O king, the Self of all, having thirty marks
knowledge of the three times, free from duality
may the Lord of three abodes protect
under the pretext of three steps
by asking for three steps as a pretext
by the three he may attain equality with me
of the strengths of austerity, yoga and splendour
the beauty of the three worlds
worshipped by the teachers of the three worlds, not stale
the command of the teacher of the three worlds
even for the wealth of the three worlds unwavering
for the wealth of the three worlds unwavering memory, sought by Ajita? gods
of those on wrong path through three pride
destroyer of the three worlds by fire
lotus feet bowed to by the Lord of the three worlds
for the sake of the three worlds
sole teacher of the three worlds
from sowing of the three aims
even of the lord of heaven
cause of threefold delusion and imagination
cause of threefold delusion and imagination, modified, tamasic
I worship with necks pierced by trident
Trishtubh from flesh, Anushtubh, Jagati from bone
from the abode of the equilibrium of the three (qualities), great
for the protection of the three worlds
attain the one who made the three worlds weep (Ravana)
the abode of the fortune of the three worlds, with all wealth, lived
removing the sin of the three worlds
powerful fortune of the three worlds
this beauty of the three worlds
obstruction of effort for the three aims by ours
obstruction of effort for the three aims, our husband ordains
followers of three aims, the old in the three Vedas
among the dwellers of heaven and others
of the lord of three, alas
in the lord of the three
skin, flesh, blood, fat, marrow, bone: the (seven) elements
one who knows your lotus feet thus
the nectar of your lotus feet
by dust of your lotus feet
the unborn should lie with lingering attachment
in the ocean of nectar of your stories
in the nectar-river of your stories
path to you, not of the self
your path, not in the self, the Self by the Self
of those who enjoy the honey of your lotus feet
by the boat of your foot
on your sides, bow and sword
your fathers, surely our fathers and grandfathers
and I helped by your father
afflicted with intense love by your beautiful smile and glance
of those whose souls are scorched by intense love at your beautiful smile and glance
by servants of yours, a king's station
is figuratively spoken because of dependence on you
by actions awakened by the maya agitated by your glance
the fragrance of the lotus-bud of your feet
sin of men destroyed by sight of you
by the speed of your thunderbolt, the worldly noose shaken
from you, giver of boons, Lord
your demons made angry at the removal of unrighteousness
those who do not know thus are not good
of those falling struck by your sword of death
in the house, Self, children, wives by your maya
of one attached to the house, Self, children, wives by your maya
having gone to wealth by your maya
O Adhokshaja, "I and mine" by your maya
you in the lifting of the unconquered
you even today are not satisfied
you, Soul of all, that was done accordingly by us
you the Self of all selves
you are the first in that
by you with the Self's half I, of keen sight
created after by you with the three selves
I worshipped by you for the protection of offspring
O Lord, I am favoured by you
of one whose mind has been churned by you
garlands, perfumes, clothes, ornaments enjoyed by you, adorned
O lotus-eyed, in you, the abode of all beings
in you this wonder through the maya of the unborn Self
but of one who has bowed
where lordship unequalled, exceeding, of the three lords
but daily, by fate comes near
to you, Soul of all, dear Lord of those who took refuge
conduct by us, the Malaya breeze
you, in the heart by Self-delighted teachers
of those like you, whose minds are on Achyuta
you, in experience, with action and purpose ceased
but between the Arjuna trees not
women with cheeks reddened by shining saffron
in the milk ocean of your stories
by chanting of him and so on
Akrura, the Sthata (resident) born of him
by men like gnats and mosquitoes and wretches
with the tusk like a mountain
with fierce tusks, brows and rod-hard face
face with fierce tusks and brows
right and left in the sky
like fire whose source is burnt
other than marks like the staff
